India's T20 Squad Faces Player Injury Ahead of Ireland and England Series

Indian cricketer Nitish Kumar Reddy has been ruled out of the upcoming T20 series against Ireland due to a quadriceps injury. His participation in the subsequent England tour is also uncertain. The Indian team has departed for the series, while Ireland and England have announced their squads, with changes in captaincy and player selections for both visiting teams.
